svg.title: Original laboratory dates and preceding upstream flow
svg.desc: USGS 02186702; fifteen chlorophyll dates plus one additional microcystin date. Prior windows exclude the laboratory date. Each window has 7/7 observed daily means; peak labels show the original date. The 95th percentile uses all 365 observed 2023 daily means. Lines connect retained laboratory dates, not all river-flow days. The gauge is upstream of the lake stations. Original sample times/timezones and each USGS source-record index are retained.

svg.text: Maximum daily mean in preceding 7 calendar days
Prior windows exclude the laboratory date. Each window has 7/7 observed daily means; peak labels show the original date.
The 95th percentile uses all 365 observed 2023 daily means. Lines connect retained laboratory dates, not all river-flow days.
The gauge is upstream of the lake stations. Original sample times/timezones and each USGS source-record index are retained.
